definitions: A graphical representation showing the intensity of emitted particles or radiation as a function of their energy, obtained from Ion Beam Analysis (IBA) techniques.
The characteristic energy distribution of ions or photons detected after a material has been bombarded with an ion beam, used for elemental composition and depth profiling.
examples: The IBA spectrum revealed the presence of trace elements.
Analyzing the IBA spectrum provides insights into the sample's structure.
Each peak in the IBA spectrum corresponds to a specific element.
